settings.title: AIS Bridge Settings
settings.aishub_username_description: Requires an AISHub membership with your own NMEA station (≥10 vessels/7 days, ≥90% uptime). Max 1 request/minute — use one username on ONE device only.
settings.ais_source_description: Shadow mode polls AISHub and logs a freshness/coverage comparison (SHADOW_COMPARE) without affecting bridge status. Switch to "Both" after reviewing at least 48 h of shadow data.
settings.debug_level_detailed: Detailed - Smart logic and boat analysis
settings.debug_level_full: Full - All AIS data and processing
settings.debug_level_description: Choose debug level for troubleshooting. Higher levels provide more detailed logs but may impact performance.
settings.instructions_valid_text: the app connects within a few seconds
settings.instructions_invalid_text: you get a timeline notification after repeated failed attempts
settings.instructions_aishub_text: the first poll starts within ~1 minute; look for AISHUB_POLL / SHADOW_COMPARE lines in the app log
settings.instructions_footer: The connection status is shown on the "Bridge Status" device in your home.
settings.status_still_loading: ⏳ Settings are still loading — try again in a moment.
settings.status_key_too_short: ❌ The API key looks too short. Check your key from aisstream.io
settings.status_bad_username: ❌ The AISHub username may only contain letters, digits, dot, underscore and dash (3-64 characters). Enter the username only — not a URL.
settings.status_source_needs_username: ❌ That source mode requires an AISHub username. Fill it in first, or keep "AISstream only".
settings.status_saved_connecting: ✅ Settings saved! The app is now trying to connect...
settings.status_saved_key_removed: ✅ Settings saved! API key removed — the AIS stream will disconnect.
